# Leaflet 1.9.4

Vendored from `leaflet@1.9.4/dist` on jsDelivr; license from the same package.
The downloaded JavaScript and CSS were verified against the SHA-256 hashes in the
[official installation instructions](https://leafletjs.com/install.html).
The optional JavaScript source map and its source-map comment are omitted.

The map uses DOM-based markers, so Leaflet's default marker images are unnecessary.
See `LICENSE` for the BSD-2-Clause terms.
